author: Chiara Parravicini

Counting of occurrences for each venue.

steps.title: Download Data Dumps
steps.instruction: Gather the necessary datasets from the following sources:

substeps.instruction: Download Crossref dump (April 2023 release, zip file of 185.88GB).
Download OpenCitations Meta dump (April 2024 release, zip file of 11GB).

steps.title: Extract Peer Review Data
steps.instruction: Extract peer review items from the compressed JSON files in the ZIP archive using a parallel processing approach in manageable batches.

substeps.instruction: Read, decompress, and parse files to identify items of type 'peer-review'.
Save entries with metadata: citing DOI, cited DOI, creation date, and author information (including names and ORCID identifiers).

steps.title: Extract Non-Peer Review Data
steps.instruction: Filter out records tagged as 'peer-review' to identify non-peer review items (e.g., journal articles, conference papers).

substeps.instruction: Capture cited DOI, URL, ISSN, venue title, and publication date.
Save results to a Non-peer review CSV.

steps.title: Generate Open Citation Identifiers (OCIs)
steps.instruction: Create unique OCIs for peer review relationships to link citing and cited entities.

substeps.instruction: Map characters in each DOI to unique codes using a pre-defined lookup table.
Format as 'oci:'.
Save to a Peer review CSV containing OCIs, citing/cited DOIs, citation dates, URLs, and author details.

steps.title: Integrate and Normalize Data
steps.instruction: Combine the peer review and non-peer review datasets into a consolidated structure.

substeps.instruction: Load and combine CSV files from both datasets.
Normalize DOI fields by removing stray characters and converting to lowercase.
Validate the existence of the 'cited_doi' column in both datasets.
Perform an inner join based on the shared 'cited_doi' column.

steps.title: Calculate Temporal Delta
steps.instruction: Calculate the temporal difference between the publication dates of citing and cited items in compliance with ISO 8601 duration format.

substeps.instruction: Parse 'citing_date' and 'cited_date' into datetime objects.
Use 'relativedelta' from the 'dateutil' library to calculate the difference in years, months, and days.
Format the result as an ISO 8601 duration string, prefixing with a minus symbol ('-') if the citing date is earlier than the cited date.

steps.title: Add Provenance Metadata
steps.instruction: Append provenance metadata based on the PROV ontology to ensure reproducibility and traceability.

substeps.instruction: Add Agent: The source of the data (e.g., https://academictorrents.com).
Add Source: DOI of the dataset.
Add Timestamp: A UTC timestamp marking the integration's execution.

steps.title: Compartmentalize Dataset
steps.instruction: Divide the unified dataset into specialized compartments for targeted analysis by cloning the full dataset twice.

substeps.instruction: Create a 'Citations' CSV: fields for OCI, citing DOI, cited DOI, citing date, citing url, author information, cited url, cited date, and time span.
Create a 'Provenance' CSV: fields for OCI, author information, provenance agent, source, and provenance date.
Create a 'Venues' CSV: fields for cited DOI, author information, cited ISSN, and cited venue.

steps.title: Normalize Venue Data
steps.instruction: Clean and structure the venue information.

substeps.instruction: Split the 'cited_issn' column into separate entries for cases with multiple ISSNs.
Separate rows with empty ISSN fields and group them by venue name only.

steps.title: Analyze Top Publication Venues
steps.instruction: Identify the most frequently cited venues.

substeps.instruction: Group venues by ISSN pairs (issn1, issn2) or by venue name alone if ISSNs are absent.
Count occurrences for each venue.
Sort the dataset by the count column to produce a 'Venue Counts' CSV and a 'Top Venues Summary' CSV.

steps.title: Process OpenCitations Meta Data
steps.instruction: Extract and classify DOIs from the OpenCitations Meta dump.

substeps.instruction: Read each CSV in the ZIP archive and extract the first column.
Identify DOIs using the 'doi:' pattern and save cleaned DOIs to a 'Meta DOIs' CSV.
Cross-reference DOIs with the Citation dataset to classify them as 'Peer Reviews' (citing entities) or 'Articles' (cited entities).
Remove duplicates using Pandas.
Calculate unique entry counts and save to a 'Summary CSV'.

steps.title: Generate RDF Representation
steps.instruction: Convert the processed CSV data into RDF graphs using the CiTO (Citation Typing Ontology) and PROV ontology.

substeps.instruction: Parse the input CSV line by line and create instances of the 'PeerReview' class.
Evaluate date precision using ISO 8601 standards (gYear, gYearMonth, or date).
Map rows to RDF triples using predicates: 'hasCitingEntity', 'hasCitedEntity', 'hasCitationTimeSpan', and 'hasCitationCreationDate'.
Select operation mode: 'Data-Only Mode' (citation relationships/attributes) or 'Provenance-Only Mode' (provenance information).
Serialize the RDF graph in Turtle format (.ttl) and stream it directly to disk to minimize memory usage.
